title: Report a food safety complaint
summary: Use this page to report food safety complaints to the NSW Food Authority.
intro: The NSW Food Authority works with local councils to ensure that food sold in NSW is labelled correctly and complies with the safety standards of the respective business sector.
who_can_apply: Possible food poisoning from a food business in more than one household
Other issues relating to food safety and labelling
what_you_need: The name and full street address of the business (if applicable)
The internet address (if the food safety or labelling problem is viewable on the site)
The date on the package (if applicable)
A description of the food that was eaten, and the time and date it was consumed
The time and date illness began
Leftover food, packaging and receipts (if practicable)
Information if food poisoning is suspected

how_to_steps.text: Read the information on the introductory page.
Follow the prompts to submit your complaint.

more_info.text: You can remain anonymous when making a complaint, but providing your name and contact details can assist the Food Authority if they want to investigate the matter further.
